user.title: Connect to Shopify Store
user.description: Enter your Shopify store details. You'll need a custom app with Admin API access.

data_description.shop_domain: Your Shopify store domain (e.g., my-store.myshopify.com or just my-store)
data_description.access_token: Admin API access token from your Shopify custom app
data_description.api_version: Shopify API version (leave default unless you have specific requirements)
data_description.timezone_override: Override the store timezone for date calculations (e.g., Australia/Sydney)
data_description.include_test_orders: Include test orders in counts and revenue calculations
data_description.mock_mode: Use mock data instead of real API calls (for testing integration)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate Shopify
reauth_confirm.description: The access token for {shop_domain} is no longer valid. Please enter a new access token.

error.invalid_auth: Invalid access token or insufficient permissions. Ensure read_orders scope is granted.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect to Shopify. Please check your internet connection and shop domain.
error.invalid_domain: Shop not found. Please verify the shop domain is correct.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the logs for details.

abort.already_configured: This Shopify store is already configured.

init.title: Shopify Options
init.description: Configure update interval and data options.

data.months_lookback: Months to Analyze for Busiest Month

data_description.scan_interval: How often to fetch data from Shopify (in minutes)
data_description.months_lookback: Number of months to look back when calculating busiest month

data_description.timezone_override: Override the store timezone for date calculations
